title: Teddy Lingerie
content:
Teddies solve lingerie’s oldest mixing problem: what to pair with what. A teddy lingerie piece is bra and brief in one continuous line — no waistband to match, no separate top to tuck, nothing riding up at midnight. The twelve here, pulled from the nightwear rails, run from a deep-V lace bodysuit through cut-out mesh to patent leather onesies, each one a finished look that goes on in a single step. The softer babydoll cut, the teddy’s nearest cousin, keeps its own page next door.

The Case for Teddy Lingerie

The cut around the hips does the talking: high-cut legs lengthen the line, boy-short hems keep things casual, and a plunge at the front decides how the whole piece reads. Closure comes next — a snap base makes a bodysuit practical, pull-on styling stays smoothest under clothes. Fabric follows mood: lace for romance, wet-look patent for drama, stretch mesh for the hours after midnight. And because one piece does the work of two, sizing leans on the height-and-weight chart rather than the waist measurement alone.

Browse the one-piece edit below — twelve styles chosen to work as one.
